references.note: For every x ≥ 25 there is a prime p with x < p < 6x/5.
references.title: J. Nagura, On the interval containing at least one prime number, Proc. Japan Acad. 28 (1952) 177–181

literature_proposed.summary: Known: Nagura (1952) proved that for every x ≥ 25 the interval (x, 6x/5) contains a prime. The proof is an explicit Chebyshev-type estimate of the prime-counting function; Mathlib has Bertrand's postulate (the interval (x, 2x]) but not this refinement.
